final_sql:
SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.`School Name` = s.School
WHERE f.`District Name` = 'SBE - The School of Arts and Enterprise'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;
